However, AAP leader Prashant Bhushan rejected this offer, indicating AAP was not interested in accepting support (Source 1). Later, Congress taunted AAP, suggesting that they were not capable of forming a government on their own (Source 2). This sequence of events shows Congress's initial support followed by a critical stance towards AAP's capabilities.
